questions.question: Please clarify “chapter XVIII, §§ 34–36”: on the supplied p. 339, 34–36 number the rules in the translation, while the adjacent verse references are §§ 22–24. Rule 34 covers multiplication and rules 35–36 division. The quotations and the author’s explicit explanation that 0/0 = 0 is a historical error are retained. Please agree an unambiguous locator for both versions.
